curation.representative_state: Earliest publication year, then activity ID; no score or potency selection

interpretation: Same assay ID narrows the experimental context; it does not prove identical conditions for every measurement.
Structured human assignment is retained; assay prose is preserved without using regex matches as biological truth.
Null variant_sequence means no variant annotation, not experimentally established wild-type sequence.
BAO labels may be incomplete or inconsistent with prose; they are audit metadata, not condition equivalence.
Repeated chemical families across assays and targets remain correlated observations, not independent replicates.
This retrospective same-assay control panel does not replace a generation benchmark train/test partition.
scope: Retained-source availability and score-blind selection only; no new chemical scores or discrimination estimates
source_sampling: First 1000 activity IDs per target and publication-year band; bounded source sample, not complete ChEMBL target inventory

tests.environment: Python from ../chembounce/.venv-synllama-min; cwd and PYTHONPATH set to this isolated worktree
